dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for reaching out. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. I'm looking forward to our session.

dialogue.origin: 相談員です。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。はじめに年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: I'm your counselor. Thank you for reaching out today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 16歳　男子
dialogue.content: I'm 16, male.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: ちょっと言いにくいですが…
dialogue.content: It's a bit difficult to say...

dialogue.origin: まずはお話しできる範囲で大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.content: That's okay. Please just share what you feel comfortable with for now.

dialogue.origin: 誰にも知られたくない事があります
dialogue.content: There's something I don't want anyone to know.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そのことで不安を抱えていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Are you feeling anxious about that?

dialogue.origin: でもそれを直したくて
dialogue.content: But I want to fix it.

dialogue.origin: 直したいとお考えなのですね。何かそう思われるきっかけなどがあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So you're thinking you want to change it. Was there anything in particular that made you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 悪い事をしてます
dialogue.content: I'm doing something bad.

dialogue.origin: 悪いことと感じることをしているのですね。でもそれを直したいと前向きにもかんがえていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: You're doing something you feel is wrong. But it's positive that you're thinking about changing it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 一歩進もうをするお考えを持てたことは素晴らしいですね。
dialogue.content: It's wonderful that you've been able to consider taking a step forward.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいですか
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。まずはもう少しあなたの思いやその行動などについて少し一緒に整理してみませんか？
dialogue.content: Let's see. First, would you be willing to take some time to sort through your thoughts and this behavior with me?

dialogue.origin: あまり人には言えません
dialogue.content: I can't really tell people about it.

dialogue.origin: 内容については言えないことは言わないで大丈夫ですよ。安心してください。
dialogue.content: It's okay not to talk about anything you don't feel ready to. Please rest assured.

dialogue.origin: でも、そのような思いを抱えて人に相談することは勇気がいりましたね。
dialogue.content: But it must have taken a lot of courage to reach out to someone while holding onto those feelings.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 一人で抱えていたことも、つらかったですね。
dialogue.content: It must have been hard carrying that all by yourself.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それでもちゃんと大人に相談しようと、判断・行動に起こすことができたね。
dialogue.content: And yet, you were able to decide to talk to an adult and take action. That's a wonderful thing.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうできたこと、大きな一歩だと思います。
dialogue.content: I think being able to do that is a big step.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 変えたくても変えられないという思いを一人で抱えてきて、どのような気持ちでいますか？
dialogue.content: How have you been feeling, holding on to this feeling of wanting to change but not being able to, all by yourself?

dialogue.origin: 難しいです
dialogue.content: It's difficult.

dialogue.origin: 難しい・・。そうですよね。言葉で表現することが難しいと、感じますか？
dialogue.content: Difficult... I understand. Do you feel it's difficult to put into words?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今は、どこでこのメッセージを送ってくれているのかな？
dialogue.content: Where are you sending these messages from right now?

dialogue.origin: 部屋です
dialogue.content: From my room.

dialogue.origin: 自分の部屋ですね。部屋の居心地はいかがですか？
dialogue.content: Your own room. How comfortable do you feel there?

dialogue.origin: 普通です
dialogue.content: It's okay.

dialogue.origin: 悪くはない、ということですね。安心しました。ご家族は今はいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.content: So, it's not bad. That's reassuring. Is your family home right now?

dialogue.origin: 父は仕事で、母はいます。
dialogue.content: My dad is at work, and my mom is here.

dialogue.origin: お母様がいらっしゃるのですね。あなたにご兄弟はいますか？
dialogue.content: Your mother is home. Do you have any siblings?

dialogue.origin: 兄がいます
dialogue.content: I have an older brother.

dialogue.origin: お兄様ですね。お兄様との関係はいかがですか？
dialogue.content: An older brother, I see. What is your relationship with him like?

dialogue.origin: 悪くはないと思うけど、兄は頭が良すぎて…
dialogue.content: I don't think it's bad, but he's too smart...

dialogue.origin: 頭が良いお兄様なのですね。
dialogue.content: So your brother is very smart.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お兄様に普段相談したりおしゃべりする機会はいかがですか？
dialogue.content: Do you usually talk or consult with your brother?

dialogue.origin: 相談はできません。
dialogue.content: I can't talk to him about things.

dialogue.origin: お兄様とは相談できないのですね。できない理由はなんでしょうね？
dialogue.content: So it's hard to talk with your brother about this. What do you think makes it difficult?

dialogue.origin: 悪い事だからです
dialogue.content: Because it's something bad.

dialogue.origin: 今回お話しされていることに関してですね。それはもちろんご家族であっても難しいことです。
dialogue.content: You mean regarding what we're discussing now. That can be hard to talk about, even with family.

dialogue.origin: ご両親やお兄様との普段の会話やほかの相談事などはいかがですか？
dialogue.content: What about your usual conversations with your parents and brother, or talking about other things?

dialogue.origin: あまり会話もないです
dialogue.content: We don't really talk much.

dialogue.origin: みんな忙しそうなので
dialogue.content: Everyone seems busy.

dialogue.origin: ご家族皆忙しく、お話しする機会が持てないのですね。それはとても寂しいですね。
dialogue.content: Your whole family is busy, so you don't get a chance to talk. That must be very lonely.

dialogue.origin: 昔からで、慣れてます
dialogue.content: It's been like that for a long time; I'm used to it.

dialogue.origin: 昔からだから慣れているのですね。小さいころからご自身で折り合いをつけてこられたのですね。
dialogue.content: So you're used to it because it's been that way for a long time. You've been finding your own way to cope since you were little.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ここで話すことは誰かに伝わるんですか？
dialogue.content: Will what I say here be shared with anyone?

dialogue.origin: いいえ。ここで相談に乗っている私と、必要だと判断されたときに相談する同じく相談員の上司にしか見られることは一切ありません。
dialogue.content: No. The only people who will see this are me, your counselor, and my supervisor, who is also a counselor, only if it's deemed necessary to consult with them. No one else will see it.

dialogue.origin: そうですか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 相談することへの不安はまだ心にありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you still feel anxious about talking with me?

dialogue.origin: 他の人に知られたくないです
dialogue.content: I don't want other people to know.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。もちろんそう思われることは当然のことです。こういった機関は必ず守秘義務というものが存在しますので、安心してください。（普段お友達などとされているラインのように他に漏れるようなことはありません）
dialogue.content: Of course. It's completely natural to feel that way. Organizations like this have a strict duty of confidentiality, so please rest assured. (It won't be leaked to others like a chat with your friends on an app like LINE.)

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫なんですね
dialogue.content: So it's safe?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.content: Yes, it's safe.

dialogue.origin: 実は、何回も万引きしました
dialogue.content: Actually, I've shoplifted many times.

dialogue.origin: どうしてもやめられないです
dialogue.content: I just can't stop.

dialogue.origin: でも、やめたいです
dialogue.content: But I want to stop.

dialogue.origin: 信頼してお話してくれて本当にありがとう。
dialogue.content: Thank you so much for trusting me and sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: やめたいのにやめられないんだね。本当に苦しかったね。
dialogue.content: You want to stop, but you can't. That must have been so painful for you.

dialogue.origin: 自分が嫌です
dialogue.content: I hate myself.

dialogue.origin: こんな自分が大嫌いです
dialogue.content: I really hate this side of myself.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。自分自身に落ち込んでしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. It's easy to feel down on yourself.

dialogue.origin: こんな奴いない方がいい
dialogue.content: It would be better if someone like me didn't exist.

dialogue.origin: 自分を消してしまいたいような気持になりますか？
dialogue.content: Do you feel like you want to make yourself disappear?

dialogue.origin: 今すぐ消したい
dialogue.content: I want to disappear right now.

dialogue.origin: それは本当に本当に苦しいね。もう少し、私とのお話しに付き合ってもらうことはできますか？
dialogue.content: That must be truly, truly painful. Would you be able to stay and talk with me a little longer?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 話せる範囲で大丈夫ですからね。
dialogue.content: Just share whatever you feel comfortable with, okay?

dialogue.origin: そういう行動に出たくなる時、自分がどんな状態になっているときかな？
dialogue.content: When you feel the urge to do that, what kind of state do you notice you're in?

dialogue.origin: 出たくなるって言うか、手が勝手に動く
dialogue.content: It's less of an urge and more like my hands move on their own.

dialogue.origin: その時のことは、あまり覚えていない感じ
dialogue.content: I don't really remember much about those moments.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。無意識な状態で手が勝手に動くという状態なのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So it's a state where your hands move on their own, almost unconsciously.

dialogue.origin: 近いかも
dialogue.content: Something like that.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。では、事が済んだ時にはどんな気持ちになったり考えが浮かんだりするかな？
dialogue.content: I understand. And after it's over, what kinds of feelings or thoughts come to mind?

dialogue.origin: あっっ！と言う感じ
dialogue.content: It's a feeling like, 'Oh no!'

dialogue.origin: またやってしまった…
dialogue.content: I've done it again...

dialogue.origin: とても嫌な気分
dialogue.content: It's a really awful feeling.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。無意識で行ったのにハッとなってとても嫌な気持ちに苛まれるのですね。それはつらいですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So even though you do it unconsciously, it hits you afterward and you're tormented by this awful feeling. That must be very hard.

dialogue.origin: そのうちバレる
dialogue.content: I'll get caught eventually.

dialogue.origin: 早くやめたい
dialogue.content: I want to stop soon.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいですか
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: そうだよね。さっき無意識とあったけれど、朝からとても機嫌がよかった時と悪い時で差はどうですか？
dialogue.content: I understand. You mentioned it feels unconscious, but is there a difference on days when you're in a very good mood from the morning versus days when you're in a bad mood?

dialogue.origin: 覚えてないです
dialogue.content: I don't remember.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。そういう行為をしなくて済んだ時ってどんな時かな？
dialogue.content: I see. What about the times when you've managed not to do it? What are those times like?

dialogue.origin: 分からない
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。あなたにとって、ついそれを行ってしまうきっかけや引き金のようなものに自覚がまだ持てていない、ということかな？
dialogue.content: I see. So, is it possible that you're not yet aware of what the cues or triggers might be that lead you to do it?

dialogue.origin: そう、分からないです
dialogue.content: Right, I don't know.

dialogue.origin: 何事も、原因やきっかけがないと結果というのは行らないものですよね。しんどくならない範囲で、そこに自分で意識を向けいかがですか？いかがですか？
dialogue.content: Everything that happens has a cause or a trigger, doesn't it? As long as it doesn't become too difficult, how would you feel about trying to turn your attention toward that?

dialogue.origin: 打ち間違えました。
dialogue.content: I made a typo.

dialogue.origin: しんどくならない範囲で、そこに自分で意識をむけてみるということはいかがですか？
dialogue.content: Within a range that doesn't feel too difficult, how about trying to bring your own awareness to that?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう。もし、こういう行為を自分で抑えることができたらどんな気分になりそうかな？
dialogue.content: Thank you. If you were able to control this behavior yourself, how do you think you would feel?

dialogue.origin: すごく嬉しいです
dialogue.content: I'd be so happy.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね。とても嬉しいよね。
dialogue.content: Right. It would feel great, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: どんなことから始められそうか、次回一緒に考えてみませんか？
dialogue.content: Would you like to think together next time about what a good first step might be?

dialogue.origin: 負担にならない範囲で大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.content: Only what you're comfortable with, of course.

dialogue.origin: 次回っていつですか
dialogue.content: When is 'next time'?

dialogue.origin: またご自身の良いタイミングでご相談してくださって大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.content: You're welcome to reach out for another session whenever the timing is right for you.

dialogue.origin: そろそろお時間になりますが、今日はお話しされてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.content: Our time is almost up for today. How did it feel to talk about things?

dialogue.origin: またやってしまう
dialogue.content: I'm just going to do it again.

dialogue.origin: 普段行為を行う時間帯の前に、少しだけでも相談にきてもらえませんか？
dialogue.content: Would you be able to come and talk, even for just a little while, before the time of day you usually do it?

dialogue.origin: でも、いつそうなるか分からない
dialogue.content: But I don't know when it's going to happen.

dialogue.origin: それでは、明日の相談時間を今決めておきましょう。何時がよいですか？
dialogue.content: In that case, let’s go ahead and set a time for tomorrow. What time would be good for you?

dialogue.origin: 学校が終わってから6時くらい
dialogue.content: Around 6:00, after school is over.

dialogue.origin: 承知しました！待っていますね。
dialogue.content: Understood! I'll be waiting for you then.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: それでは、明日またよろしくお願いいたします。今日はゆっくり休んでくださいね。本日はご相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: All right then, I look forward to speaking with you again tomorrow. Please get some good rest tonight. Thank you for your consultation today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ★本日はありがとうございました。ロールプレイ終了させていただきます。
dialogue.content: ★Thank you for today. This concludes the role-play session.

dialogue.origin: (お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました！)
dialogue.content: (Good work today. Thank you!)

topic.sub: 自己嫌悪とストレスによる行動問題
